decisions.reason: An evening psychiatric day-patient program builds on the firm's core clinical competence, serves unmet demand from working patients, is reimbursed and has its own page, so it likely meets aspirations while the firm's growth provides slack.

The custom-furniture carpentry extends the existing sheltered workshop's production know-how at low incremental cost and gives participants meaningful work, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.

Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's psychiatric offer, but it is only mentioned on the website and the service is often hard to staff and finance, so there is some risk, though slack from expansion supports continuing it.
Senior-living counseling is featured on the home page and channels clients into the core eldercare business, so it clearly meets management's aspirations.

The retail shop is only mentioned on the website and faces uncertain retail results, but it supports the workshop's sales and visibility, and the expanding firm has the slack to carry it while its results are still unclear.
